name: «Электроника 6.15М» — настольные электронные часы (зелёный ВФД, красный корпус)
description: Soviet 6.15М bedside/desk digital alarm clock, red plastic colour variant: glossy red shell, a light clear-acrylic bezel framing a smoked-black front filter, an ИВЛ1-7/5 green VFD reading HH:MM, a top snooze button, the С/Я/К/Б/Ч/М control column on the left wall, and a grey mains lead out the rear. The green readout itself is a live CanvasTexture screen added at integration (reads the game world clock 1:1) — this spec builds the physical body + the smoked front it glows through.

parts.name: Slim dark base/foot the shell stands on
parts.note: Low moulded base under the front (dossier feature 'stands on a small base/foot'); exact foot dims in needs[]

parts.name: Red glossy plastic shell (wide-short-deep box)
parts.note: 195×75×100 mm case (case_dimensions); 75 mm split as 10 base + 72 body ≈ 82 overall

parts.name: Light clear-acrylic front bezel frame (catches light, frames the panel)
parts.note: Translucent clear/acrylic front frame read as a light grey rim in voxel (no transparency); front at z≈0.055, embeds into the red body

parts.name: Smoked-black front filter (the dark screen the green digits glow through)
parts.note: Glossy near-black smoked filter, ~3 mm proud of the bezel, smaller so the bezel frames it; the live green VFD screen mounts on its front face (z≈0.058) at integration

parts.name: Top snooze/light button (round, forward of centre)
parts.note: Round top control visible in the reference photo; size is a photo-proportion derivation (see needs[]) — embeds ~3.5 mm, stands ~3.5 mm proud

parts.name: Grey twin mains lead exiting the rear-bottom
parts.note: Short exit stub out the bottom-rear; the full drape off the shelf is not modelled (needs[])

needs: Top button: exact size/type (snooze vs light) unsourced — modelled at photo-proportion; confirm against a passport/teardown
Side-button column placement is per the teardown (left wall) — the RED plastic variant may carry them on the front instead (dossier#buttons / dossier.needs)
Smoked-filter clear aperture and the green screen's exact size are DERIVED from the ИВЛ1-7/5 digit cluster (dossier#derivation), not measured
Case wall thickness, corner radius and base/foot dims are approximated (dossier.needs) — overall 195×75×100 is a single marketplace source
Mains cable drape past the shelf edge not modelled (floor-anchored prop); only the rear exit stub is built

The live green VFD readout (HH:MM, colon, alarm dot, «электроника» logo) is NOT in this voxel spec — it is a CanvasTexture screen mounted on the panel front at game integration, reading the world clock
